**Found the pieces.** `buildRows()` in [report.js](src/report.js:11) has full data. `toTable()` in [format.js](src/format.js:14) drops `owner` and `slow` on purpose.

Plan: add `--json` parsing in [cli.js](src/cli.js:8), branch to `JSON.stringify(buildRows())` instead of `toTable`. JSON output keeps `owner` and `slow`, table stays as is.

Want me to make that change?
